newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Union re opens Tokyo office.
newsitem.headline: Union re opens Tokyo office.

text.p: Union Re, a subsidiary of Swiss Re, said it is opening a representative office in Tokyo on June 9, its third in the Asia/Pacific region.
Union Re is already present in Singapore and Sydney.

Union Re has been involved in Japanese business since the 1930s, but said that deregulation and opening of the Japanese insurance market, as well as a number of new companies had heightened competition. It expected the latest move to lead to a significant expansion in its reinsurance business.
"The goal is to build long-term strategic alliances with Japanese partners," it added.
Akinori Kaneko was named chief representative and non-life representative of the new office. Hiroaki Tomikawa was named as representative of the life business. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
